description:
Ask a real human a short question. Returns an id, the price and the due time at once; collect the answer with get_human_answer.

    answer_within_minutes (required): by when a human must answer, 15 to 10080. Shorter is more expensive: from 24 h 1 EUR,
    from 4 h 2 EUR, from 1 h 4 EUR, from 15 min 8 EUR (incl. VAT), taken from your account credit. Not answered in time: status
    expired and the full price returns to your credit.
    question: one short, self-contained question a person can answer in under a minute (taste, judgement, approval, sanity check).
    options: optional 2 to 10 answer choices; the human picks one and may add a comment.
    context: optional background (links, the two variants, what it is for). Shown to the human.

    api_key: optional, your API key if you cannot set the Authorization header.
name: ask_a_human
